predictions.P17: compressed eps < baseline eps in both bases, 2-sigma intervals separated (plain matching, 10000 shots)
predictions.P18: break-even NOT reached in either basis: tau_logical / tau_physical upper 2-sigma bound < 1
predictions.P19: ratio tau_logical / tau_physical inside 0.10-0.35 in both bases
predictions.P20: no physical reference qubit errs above 10% at its shortest wait (dead-qubit filter works)
predictions.P21: live-probe model eps within +-30% of hardware for all 4 arms (rounds 1-4 fit)

rules: Logical arm for break-even = the 'compressed' arm of each basis. Physical reference = the 3 usable qubits with the longest probe T1 (Z) / T2 (X); the best FITTED lifetime of the 3 is used. Unusable = mean readout > 10%, either readout > 15%, or T1 not identifiable / > 2000 us.
